Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
SPEED:

Innate: Kled rides his semi-trusty steed, Skaarl, whom takes damage for him while he is Mounted. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts, cleansing from all crowd control. Kled remains Dismounted until he returns to the summoning platform, but can restore Skaarl's Courage by fighting enemies. At maximum Courage, Kled becomes Mounted with a portion of Skaarl's health. Dismounted: Kled gains bonus movement speed while moving toward enemy champions, but his basic attacks deal less damage to champions. Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced with Pocket Pistol, and Kled cannot cast his other abilities.
Innate: Kled rides his semi-trusty mount, Skaarl. While Mounted, all damage dealt to the duo is suffered by Skaarl, who has 400 – 1400 (based on level) base health; additional sources of health are applied to Skaarl's maximum health. Effects based on percentage health consider Kled and Skaarl's combined maximum health.
Being reduced below 0 health causes Skaarl to flee, forcing Kled to be Dismounted, with all damage in excess of Skaarl's health being ignored. Upon dismounting, Kled lunges in the direction of the allied Nexus, though not through terrain, while cleansing himself of all crowd control and becoming unable to act, untargetable, and immune to crowd control for 0.5 seconds. Dismounting resets the cooldown and charges of Pocket Pistol.
While Kled is Dismounted, his base health and movement speed are reduced; however, he gains bonus movement speed while moving toward enemy champions. Additionally, he gains bonus attack range, and his attacks deal 85% / 90% / 95% / 100% (based on level) damage to champions. Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced with Pocket Pistol, while Jousting and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! become unusable.
While Mounted, healing and health regeneration will first replenish Skaarl's health and will only apply to Kled's health while Skaarl is at full health.
For more details, check the Dismounted part of the ability.

Kled and Skaarl's health bar is split in two segments, representing each of them respectively.
While Mounted, Kled's health is visually rounded up while Skaarl's health is rounded down.
While Dismounted, Kled's health is visually rounded down while Skaarl's health is rounded up.
Excess damage dealt to Skaarl counts for the purposes of effects based on damage dealt (eg. Death's Dance's Ignore Pain, Stormsurge's Stormraider, item damage trackers).(unexpected)
The dismount threshold does not interact with the threshold of Lifeline effects, meaning both can be triggered from the same damage instance even if triggering one should prevent triggering the other.(bug)
If Kled dismounts and triggers a Lifeline shield effect from the same damage instance, excess damage dealt to Skaarl will be dealt to the shield when it exceeds the lifeline threshold.(unexpected)[1]
If Skaarl's health is reduced below 0 by an attack or ability with multiple damage instances, subsequent damage instances from the same cast instance are reduced to 0 damage.
The Collector's Death is special cased to not affect Kled while he is Mounted, regardless of the duo's combined current health.
If Skaarl's health is reduced below 0 by Eclipse's Ever Rising Moon, Kled will take the triggering attack's damage.(unexpected)
While untargetable, Kled rapidly destroys enemy projectiles targeting him.
Kled's gameplay radius does not change when becoming Mounted or Dismounted, even though his model size changes visually.
Kled does not receive damage from Illaoi's Test of Spirit, Kayn's Umbral Trespass, or being Regurgitated by Tahm Kench while dismounting.(bug)
The lunge can pass through player-generated terrain.(unexpected)
Buying items while Kled and Skaarl's combined current health is lower than Kled's maximum health will cause Kled to dismount upon undoing the purchase and potentially lose health.(bug)
PENDING FOR TEST: Dismounting with a spell shield sometimes consumes the spell shield and negates the effects of dismounting.(bug)[2]
If Kled would be executed while Mounted, he is instead only Dismounted.

Active: Kled & Skaarl become ghosted and unstoppably charge to a location, building up bonus movement speed and shield and leaving a draft in their wake that grants Mr. Kled's Wild Ride to allies that follow the draft. Skaarl dashes to the first enemy champion encountered, knocking them back, and dealing magic damage based on travel time. Mr. Kled's Wild Ride: Gain a large amount of movement speed.
Active: Kled & Skaarl charge toward the target location, automatically navigating terrain along the way, during which they are ghosted, immune to crowd control and revealed to enemy champions in a 1250 radius. If the charge does not complete within 15 seconds, it will end prematurely. The charge is interrupted instantly if Kled dismounts during it.
While charging, the duo gain an initial shield, plus an additional amount for every 0.25 seconds of traveling, up to a cap at 2 seconds. The shield lasts for 2 seconds upon finishing the charge. Additionally, the duo trails a directional draft in their wake, lasting 9 seconds. Allied units other than lane minions following the draft gain Mr. Kled's Wild Ride. After 0.5 seconds of charging, the duo gain bonus movement speed every 0.25 seconds, up to 950 total movement speed over 3 seconds.
Total Shield:200 / 300 / 400 (+ 300% bonus AD)
Initial Shield:40 / 60 / 80 (+ 60% bonus AD)Shield Per Instance:20 / 30 / 40 (+ 30% bonus AD)
Mr. Kled's Wild Ride: While in champion combat, gain 40% bonus movement speed. After not being in champion combat for 3 seconds, if Kled is charging, gain bonus movement speed up to Kled's current movement speed; otherwise gain up to 650 total movement speed.
Kled & Skaarl will dash toward the first visible enemy champion in range of the charge, revealing the target during the dash and colliding with the first visible enemy champion in their path to deal magic damage, increased by 0% – 200% (based on charge time), knock them back 150 units, though not through terrain, and end the charge.

The Charge
While charging, if any out of sight enemy champions were within 500 range of Kled during the last second, Kled locks on to the closest visible enemy champion within 800 range in his facing direction, and begins dashing toward them.
During the charge the duo gain (950 − (starting movement speed)) ÷ 12 × (time ÷ 0.25) bonus movement speed
The bonus movement speed is not affected by movement speed caps.
The charge will not give any movement speed to the duo if they have more than 「 1440 raw movement speed 」「 950 after movement speed soft caps 」.
The trail will not give Kled and his allies any movement speed out-of-champion-combat if they have more than 「 840 raw movement speed 」「 650 after movement speed soft caps 」.
Movement speed is granted by facing the direction of the draft and lasts for 0.528 seconds upon exiting the trail or facing another direction.
Voidmites, and Bel'Veth's Void Remora are considered to be lane minions for the purpose of Mr. Kled's Wild Ride.
Kled will re-path if his current path is blocked by a newly created terrain (either player created or by the Mountainous Rift).
The charge will continue towards the target location even if Kled's location changes drastically.
Kled will mark his path with an indicator visible to him and his allies.
Kled's pathing indicator will not account for changes in Kled's pathing.
Kled's pathing indicator will sometimes display a path different from his real path.(bug) [3]
Kled's shield generation is based upon a global 0.25 second timer, not based on when the ability is cast or when it ends.(unexpected)
For example, this means that Kled will take an additional 0.25 seconds to generate the maximum shield amount if the ability was cast immediately after the last tick of the global timer.
For example, this means that Kled's shield will expire 0.25 seconds sooner if his charge ends immediately before the next tick of the global timer.
Axiom Arcanist only increases the first instance of shield gained.(bug)
The Dash
If Kled passes over the charge's target location, the charge will end even during the dash.(bug)
If the charge ends before, or during the dash, the dash will not:
Generate a shield;
Trail a directional draft, applying Mr. Kled's Wild Ride;
Disable summoner spells and items.
Kled sometimes fails to lock on to valid targets in range.(bug) [4]
Experimental Hexplate's Overdrive, Fiendhunter Bolts' Opening Barrage, and Zeke's Convergence's Frostfire Tempest trigger at the end of the charge or at the end of the dash, whichever comes last, even if the charge ends before or during the dash.
Kled and Skaarl will track the target if they change locations.
They will dash to the target's previous location if the target moves beyond 2500 units of the dash's beginning location.
If the target moves 2500 or more units away from Kled and Skaarl during the dash, it will be interrupted.
If the dash does not complete within 9 seconds, Kled and Skaarl will continue to track their target, but will be able to cast spells, and will not be able to collide with enemy champions.
While dashing, Kled will mark his target with an indicator visible to both teams.
The damage dealt is based on time spent traveling before the beginning of the dash.
It is possible for Kled to briefly lose his crowd control immunity while colliding with an enemy champion, which can allow the dash, and its subsequent damage and displacement to get interrupted.(bug) [5]
Units knocked back by Chaaaaaaaarge!!! knockback can pass through terrain if it is player-generated, or if they are already inside it.(unexpected)
The airborne debuff is removed early when the forced movement stops.
Buffering Interactions
Nothing can be buffered during the charge.
Movement and attack commands, as well as Bear Trap on a Rope and Jousting can be buffered during the dash.

Tips & Tricks
Since movement speed lost from slows is not regained when they expire while Kled is charging, it's advised for players to wait for short duration slows and similar debuffs (eg. Galio's Shield of Durand) to expire before casting Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.

The Charge
While charging, if any out of sight enemy champions were within 500 range of Kled during the last second, Kled locks on to the closest visible enemy champion within 800 range in his facing direction, and begins dashing toward them.
During the charge the duo gain (950 − (starting movement speed)) ÷ 12 × (time ÷ 0.25) bonus movement speed
The bonus movement speed is not affected by movement speed caps.
The charge will not give any movement speed to the duo if they have more than 「 1440 raw movement speed 」「 950 after movement speed soft caps 」.
The trail will not give Kled and his allies any movement speed out-of-champion-combat if they have more than 「 840 raw movement speed 」「 650 after movement speed soft caps 」.
Movement speed is granted by facing the direction of the draft and lasts for 0.528 seconds upon exiting the trail or facing another direction.
Voidmites, and Bel'Veth's Void Remora are considered to be lane minions for the purpose of Mr. Kled's Wild Ride.
Kled will re-path if his current path is blocked by a newly created terrain (either player created or by the Mountainous Rift).
The charge will continue towards the target location even if Kled's location changes drastically.
Kled will mark his path with an indicator visible to him and his allies.
Kled's pathing indicator will not account for changes in Kled's pathing.
Kled's pathing indicator will sometimes display a path different from his real path.(bug) [3]
Kled's shield generation is based upon a global 0.25 second timer, not based on when the ability is cast or when it ends.(unexpected)
For example, this means that Kled will take an additional 0.25 seconds to generate the maximum shield amount if the ability was cast immediately after the last tick of the global timer.
For example, this means that Kled's shield will expire 0.25 seconds sooner if his charge ends immediately before the next tick of the global timer.
Axiom Arcanist only increases the first instance of shield gained.(bug)
The Dash
If Kled passes over the charge's target location, the charge will end even during the dash.(bug)
If the charge ends before, or during the dash, the dash will not:
Generate a shield;
Trail a directional draft, applying Mr. Kled's Wild Ride;
Disable summoner spells and items.
Kled sometimes fails to lock on to valid targets in range.(bug) [4]
Experimental Hexplate's Overdrive, Fiendhunter Bolts' Opening Barrage, and Zeke's Convergence's Frostfire Tempest trigger at the end of the charge or at the end of the dash, whichever comes last, even if the charge ends before or during the dash.
Kled and Skaarl will track the target if they change locations.
They will dash to the target's previous location if the target moves beyond 2500 units of the dash's beginning location.
If the target moves 2500 or more units away from Kled and Skaarl during the dash, it will be interrupted.
If the dash does not complete within 9 seconds, Kled and Skaarl will continue to track their target, but will be able to cast spells, and will not be able to collide with enemy champions.
While dashing, Kled will mark his target with an indicator visible to both teams.
The damage dealt is based on time spent traveling before the beginning of the dash.
It is possible for Kled to briefly lose his crowd control immunity while colliding with an enemy champion, which can allow the dash, and its subsequent damage and displacement to get interrupted.(bug) [5]
Units knocked back by Chaaaaaaaarge!!! knockback can pass through terrain if it is player-generated, or if they are already inside it.(unexpected)
The airborne debuff is removed early when the forced movement stops.
Buffering Interactions
Nothing can be buffered during the charge.
Movement and attack commands, as well as Bear Trap on a Rope and Jousting can be buffered during the dash.

Tips & Tricks
Like other dashes with a cast time, the recoil can be used to override forced displacement by beginning the cast shortly before the displacement takes effect.
Like other dashes, Pocket Pistol's dash will end prematurely when colliding with terrain it can't pass, allowing Kled to act early.
Pocket Pistol is not worth using for out-of-combat mobility if Kled has more than ~470 movement speed.
